newsitem.title: UK: Top Lloyds, HSBC bankers sell stock.
newsitem.headline: Top Lloyds, HSBC bankers sell stock.

text.p: The chief executive of Britain's Midland Bank and the international banking director of Lloyds Bank reported personal or family sales of shares in their respective banking groups on Thursday.
Midland's Keith Whitson exercised options to acquire 8,577 shares in the bank's parent HSBC Holdings Plc and then sold them on October 14, the company said.
The shares were bought at 7.2184 stg and sold at 12.71 stg, for a gross transaction value of just over 109,000 stg.
At Lloyds TSB Group, David Pirrie reported the sale from various family holdings of 64,896 shares on October 15, at 413p.
That transaction had a value of just over 268,000 stg.
Both companies gave details of the deals in routine statements of disclosure in line with regulatory requirements.
Since the sales Lloyds share price has eased to stand at 404p at 1520 GMT on Thursday, unchanged on the day, while HSBC jumped in the session to stand up 20p at 12.935 stg by 1520 GMT.
